name: Alert scope
description: Who an alert is intended to reach, from OASIS CAP 1.2. Publishing a restricted or private alert to an open endpoint defeats the distinction, so scope is required.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Public
hasDefinedTerm.description: For general dissemination to unrestricted audiences.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Restricted
hasDefinedTerm.description: For dissemination only to users sharing a known operational requirement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Private
hasDefinedTerm.description: For dissemination only to specified addressees.
